question: What is the discount percentage in the scheme of buy 5 get 3 free?
solution:
Given∶

An offer, ‘Buy 5 get 3 free.

Formula Used∶

Discount = Marked Price – Selling Price

Discount % = (Discount / Marked Price) × 100

Calculation∶

Let cost of 1 article be Rs. 100

Total number of articles got = 5 + 3 = 8

Number of articles purchased = 5

M.P. of 8 articles = 100 × 8 = Rs. 800

S.P. of 5 articles = 100 × 5 = Rs. 500

Discount = M.P. – S.P.

⇒ 800 – 500

⇒ Rs. 300

Discount % = (Discount / M. P.) × 100

⇒ (300 / 800) × 100

⇒ 37.5 %

∴ The net percentage of discount is 37.5%.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
